event: Born Aug 29, Gary, Indiana; father a steel-mill crane operator
Jackson 5 formed; father's rigorous fear-based rehearsal regime begins
Motown audition; family relocates to Los Angeles
I Want You Back hits #1; childhood becomes full-time work
Off the Wall - first real creative-control push
Pepsi commercial scalp burn - documented start of pain-medication exposure
Moonwalk publishes his own account of the beatings and fear; buys Neverland
Oprah interview: describes crying from loneliness, fear of his father, vomiting when he saw him
